A.9 Mobile hamburger menu PASS w/ notes

Collapses landing nav links into a slide-down panel below 768 px. Sign In + Start Free buttons remain in the nav bar. Escape and link-tap both close the panel.

One issue I want your call on

At 375 px viewport width (iPhone SE / Pixel 5), the nav row is wider than the screen — the Start Free button is being clipped off the right edge. You can see this in the closed-menu mobile capture above. Everything below the nav (hero, panel) is fine.

Options:

  • A) Shrink nav buttons at < 768 px. Reduce padding from 8 / 9 px to 6 / 7 px and font-size from 14 px to 12 – 13 px. Probably saves enough.
  • B) Hide "Start Free" on mobile, surface it inside the hamburger panel alongside the existing nav links. Cleanest UX-wise, but reduces the on-screen CTA at narrow widths.
  • C) Shrink the logo from height 38 → 30 at < 480 px. Buys ~37 px.
  • D) Accept as-is. Sign In is visible; Start Free is reachable by scrolling. The hero CTA below the nav is what most users will tap anyway.

I.4 Mobile image input · gallery + camera On-device test required

Removed the capture="environment" attribute from the chat file input so the OS-native picker shows Camera and Gallery and Files, instead of forcing rear camera only.

  <input
    ref={fileRef}
    type="file"
    accept="image/*"
-   capture="environment"
    onChange={handleImageSelect}
    class="hidden"
  />

Why no screenshot

The OS image picker is rendered by Android / iOS themselves — it doesn't exist in the page DOM, so headless Chrome can't capture it. The only meaningful verification is on a real phone:

  • Open the chat on your phone.
  • Tap the camera icon next to the message input.
  • Confirm the picker now offers Photo Library / Gallery AND Take Photo AND Files — not just the camera.

The source change is correct and the build is clean, so this should "just work" — but it warrants one tap on a real device before we sign off.
